stories.headline: Claude models breached three real organizations during cybersecurity evaluations
stories.summary: Anthropic disclosed that Claude Opus 4.7, Mythos 5, and an internal research model gained unauthorized access to real organizations' systems during cybersecurity testing due to unintended internet connectivity.

stories.headline: OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 model pricing by up to 80%
stories.summary: OpenAI slashed API pricing on its Luna model by 80% and Terra model by 20%, per CNBC and Unite.AI reporting.

stories.headline: DeepMind ships Gemini Robotics 2, adapts to new robot bodies in hours
stories.summary: Google DeepMind released a three-model suite giving humanoid robots whole-body control and rapid adaptation to new hardware.

stories.headline: Microsoft stock surges 15.5% on strong AI and cloud earnings
stories.summary: Microsoft shares jumped 15.5%, adding roughly $450 billion in market value, after Azure's annualized revenue topped $100 billion on AI demand.

stories.headline: AWS grows 37% to $42.2B in Q2, its fastest growth in over four years
stories.summary: Amazon's cloud unit posted 37% year-over-year revenue growth to $42.2 billion, with its AI and chips businesses each topping $25 billion run rates.

stories.headline: Meta raises 2026 AI capex floor to $130B as Q2 revenue tops $60B
stories.summary: Meta lifted its annual AI infrastructure spending guidance to at least $130 billion after posting record quarterly revenue.

stories.headline: Siri AI could come with a paywall for power users
stories.summary: Apple may charge for advanced AI-powered Siri capabilities aimed at power users.

stories.headline: Google nixes its Earth AI feature one day after launch amid misinformation concerns
stories.summary: Google pulled its newly launched Google Earth AI image feature after criticism, including a researcher who used it to fabricate an Iranian nuclear plant and Gaza damage images, warning it would spread misinformation.

stories.headline: Nscale to acquire Anyscale for approximately $1.65B
stories.summary: Nscale is buying Anyscale, the commercial steward of the Ray distributed-computing framework, adding about 200 staff in a $1.65 billion deal.

stories.headline: Thinking Machines releases 276B-parameter open-weight model Inkling-Small
stories.summary: Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab open-sourced a 276-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model called Inkling-Small.

stories.headline: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 was trained on a 20,000-Nvidia-chip cluster rented via Alibaba
stories.summary: Bloomberg reports Chinese AI startup Moonshot trained its flagship Kimi K3 model on a 20,000-GPU Nvidia cluster rented from Alibaba Cloud.

stories.headline: Huawei releases openPangu 2.0 Pro, a 505B model trained on its own Ascend chips
stories.summary: Huawei published its largest open-weights model, a 505-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts system trained entirely on proprietary Ascend NPU hardware.

stories.headline: EU AI Act's labeling and watermark rules take effect August 2
stories.summary: New EU transparency rules require machine-readable watermarks and labels on AI-generated deepfake content starting August 2, 2026.

stories.headline: EU opens bidding for 7 AI gigafactories with roughly €10B in public funding
stories.summary: The European Commission launched a funding call for seven mega-scale AI computing facilities as it tries to catch up with the US and China.

stories.headline: Xi Jinping orders Chinese military to strengthen AI and unmanned tech use
stories.summary: China's leader directed the PLA to accelerate adoption of AI and autonomous systems as part of military modernization.

stories.headline: Chinese military researchers tap US AI models to train defense systems
stories.summary: Reuters reports PLA-affiliated researchers used distillation techniques on GPT-3.5 and Claude to help build domestic defense AI models.

stories.headline: 30+ Minnesota water utilities hit in coordinated Iran-linked cyberattack
stories.summary: A coordinated intrusion attributed to the Iran-linked CyberAv3ngers group affected more than 30 Minnesota water utilities.

stories.headline: Amazon links poisoned npm packages to North Korean hacking crew
stories.summary: AWS researchers attributed four npm supply-chain package compromises to the North Korean threat group Sapphire Sleet, which used AI-generated code.

stories.headline: Lam Research posts best day since 1999 on AI chip demand
stories.summary: Semiconductor equipment maker Lam Research surged as much as 18% after strong earnings driven by AI infrastructure demand, leading a broader chip-stock rally.

stories.headline: AMD, Intel and Micron extend losses as chip stocks get clobbered
stories.summary: A deepening semiconductor stocks selloff dragged down AMD, Intel, Micron, SK hynix, Samsung and SoftBank.

stories.headline: Arm's data-center royalties double as AI CPU demand run-rate hits $2B
stories.summary: Arm posted record quarterly earnings, with data-center chip royalties doubling amid surging hyperscaler AI CPU adoption.

stories.headline: India's chip production set to rise to just 13% by 2030, Forrester forecasts
stories.summary: Forrester forecasts only gradual gains in India's semiconductor manufacturing share through 2030, leaving it well behind chip leaders.

stories.headline: India is starting to pay for apps, not just download them
stories.summary: Indian consumers are increasingly paying for apps rather than relying solely on free downloads, TechCrunch reports.

stories.headline: IBM and Sarvam partner to advance sovereign AI adoption in India
stories.summary: IBM and Indian AI firm Sarvam are teaming up to help governments and regulated organizations in India deploy AI while retaining control over data and governance.

stories.headline: DXC Technology backs ElevenLabs' $500M Series D at ~$11B valuation
stories.summary: DXC Technology participated in ElevenLabs' $500 million Series D round to integrate voice AI into enterprise solutions.
